text: I can compare short polling, long polling, SSE and WebSockets on latency, server cost, direction and proxy compatibility.
I can explain when to use SSE vs WebSockets and give a concrete example for each.
I can describe how WebSocket connections are established (HTTP upgrade) and their full-duplex nature.
I can explain how to scale WebSocket connections using multiple servers, a pub/sub bus and heartbeats.
I can explain long polling's advantages over short polling and its drawbacks compared to SSE/WebSockets.
I can size a WebSocket fleet (users ÷ connections per server) and plan for the reconnect storm when one server dies.
